AccountChange.description: What the owner changes on an account they keep: its name, or what it holds now.
AccountChange.title: AccountChange

AccountIn.description: An account the owner keeps by hand: a cash box, or a bank not connected.
AccountIn.title: AccountIn

AccountKind.description: Where a company's money is held (ADR-0026).
AccountKind.title: AccountKind

AdviceOut.description:
The controller's opinion on one evaluation: it moves nothing. The rules decide what can
be approved, and the owner approves.
AdviceOut.title: AdviceOut

AssistantOut.description:
What whoever asks in a chat may choose for an answer, and what an answer is given when
nothing is chosen.
AssistantOut.title: AssistantOut

CardKind.description:
The cards code puts under a message of Tamga's, as a client knows them: what the card
is about says which record its id names.
CardKind.title: CardKind

CardMessage.description:
A card code put in a chat, carried as the chat protocol's activity message. A client
draws it from the record it names, which it reads like any other.
CardMessage.title: CardMessage

ChainAnchorOut.description:
The newest anchor on the chain that holds the company's head: the row it anchored, and
whether the log still has that row as it was.
ChainAnchorOut.title: ChainAnchorOut

ChatMessages.description:
A chat's messages as the chat protocol (AG-UI) carries them, oldest first: what a client
hands its runtime to show the chat. The server keeps its own copy and never reads a client's
back (ADR-0006).
ChatMessages.title: ChatMessages

ChecklistItemOut.description:
One item of a project's or a truck's checklist, as it stands: ``done`` (a confirmed paper,
or the owner's mark), ``waiting`` (a paper suggested, a proof not yet marked, a bill not yet
paid), ``missing``, or ``not_needed``. ``link_ids`` are the project links that fill it.
ChecklistItemOut.title: ChecklistItemOut

ChecklistMarkKind.description: The owner's word on one item of a project's or a truck's checklist.
ChecklistMarkKind.title: ChecklistMarkKind

Choices.description:
What the judge chose of the scenario's policy before it opened; the rest is the
scenario's own.
Choices.title: Choices

CompactionMessage.description:
Where a chat was compacted, carried as an activity message: runs are sent notes in place
of the messages above it, which a reader still sees.
CompactionMessage.title: CompactionMessage

CompanyMode.description: What Tamga may do for the company (ADR-0009).
CompanyMode.title: CompanyMode

CompanyProfile.description:
Who the company is: the name it goes by, its legal name and tax number, and the mail
domains it writes from, each with what shows it.
CompanyProfile.title: CompanyProfile

DecisionAction.description:
The owner's answer to the evaluation it names: one for an evaluation since replaced is
refused. ``edit`` changes the amount and ``pay_by`` the way it is paid, each a new proposal:
every rule runs again, and it comes back to the owner. ``mark_paid`` says the owner paid it
in the bank, for what left their account (ADR-0027); ``undo_paid`` takes that back, for a
bank transfer settled by mistake, with the owner's reason if they give one.
DecisionAction.title: DecisionAction

DecisionChainOut.description:
The company's decision log as a whole: how many rows it holds, the hash its newest row
ends on, the first row whose hash does not hold, if any, and its last anchor.
DecisionChainOut.title: DecisionChainOut

DocumentBrief.description: A linked file, for the project's timeline: when and how it came.
DocumentBrief.title: DocumentBrief

DocumentPartOut.description: A file in an archive, under the name it had there.
DocumentPartOut.title: DocumentPartOut

DomainSource.description: What shows a mail domain is the company's.
DomainSource.title: DomainSource

FieldSource.description: Where an editable field's value came from; the owner's always wins (ADR-0010).
FieldSource.title: FieldSource

Holder.description:
What keeps a file besides the uploads of it: a mail it came in, a project it is evidence
on.
Holder.title: Holder

Holding.description: One account's balance, in its own currency and in the one asked for.
Holding.title: Holding

Holdings.description:
What the company holds, account by account, and in total in one currency. Test USDC and
accounts with no known balance are not money held, so they are not here.
Holdings.title: Holdings

HtmlOut.description: A web page made safe to show, for a frame that runs no script.
HtmlOut.title: HtmlOut

InvoiceBrief.description: A linked invoice, for the project's timeline.
InvoiceBrief.title: InvoiceBrief

InvoiceTotal.description: What the invoices a list holds add up to in one currency.
InvoiceTotal.title: InvoiceTotal

ItemNamed.description: An item something was read from, as a line naming it shows it.
ItemNamed.title: ItemNamed

JobReading.description: What a model read in a conversation: a proposal for the owner, never a fact.
JobReading.title: JobReading

LinkCreate.description: The owner attaching an item to a project by hand: confirmed at once.
LinkCreate.title: LinkCreate

LocationContact.description:
Who is asked where the truck is: its dispatcher when it has one (who already talks to the
driver), otherwise the driver (ADR-0011).
LocationContact.title: LocationContact

Me.description: Who is signed in, the company this session acts for, and every company they belong to.
Me.title: Me

MemoryChange.description:
The owner's change to an entry: only the fields given change. ``held`` confirms a draft or
takes a retired entry back; ``retired`` takes it out of every agent's reach. A firm or a
project sent as null is cleared.
MemoryChange.title: MemoryChange

MemoryChangeDone.description: One change the memorist made: an entry added, changed or retired, as it now stands.
MemoryChangeDone.title: MemoryChangeDone

MemoryIn.description: An entry the owner writes in Settings: it holds as it is saved.
MemoryIn.title: MemoryIn

MemoryKind.description: What an entry of the company's memory is (ADR-0024).
MemoryKind.title: MemoryKind

MemoryText.description:
What someone wrote in Settings for Tamga to remember, change or forget, in their own words
(ADR-0030). ``entry_id``: the entry an edit is about.
MemoryText.title: MemoryText

MessageBrief.description: A linked mail, for the project's timeline.
MessageBrief.title: MessageBrief

MovementChange.description: The owner's category for a movement; it stays through every later sync.
MovementChange.title: MovementChange

MovementIn.description: One movement the owner says happened: "a partner took 20,000 in cash".
MovementIn.title: MovementIn

Origin.description: Who began a chat, or a run in one (ADR-0018). Either way it is an ordinary chat.
Origin.title: Origin

Outcome-Input.description: What the linker made of a conversation (docs/architecture/09).
Outcome-Input.title: Outcome

PaymentRunOut.description:
The bills to pay on a day: those due by the next run after it, or overdue, that wait for
the owner or were approved and not paid yet, in the order they are weighed against the
accounts; and what the reserve leaves to pay them with. Figures are the policy's currency.
PaymentRunOut.title: PaymentRunOut

PaymentsRecorded.description:
How the company records a payment in its books (ADR-0022): what the Books page shows of an
open invoice, and whether pay-when-paid counts a client invoice paid on account as paid.
PaymentsRecorded.title: PaymentsRecorded

PlacementDecision.description:
The owner's answer, one of two. ``links``: every link that waits between the conversation's
mails and its project is confirmed or rejected. ``project_id``: the conversation belongs to
this project, whatever was suggested; with ``from_project_id`` it is moved there.
PlacementDecision.title: PlacementDecision

PlacementOut.description: Where the linker placed a conversation, and why.
PlacementOut.title: PlacementOut

PlateSeen.description:
A plate a project's mail, papers or bills name, with each item naming it, oldest first,
and the truck of the project it is, if any (a misread of its plate counts).
PlateSeen.title: PlateSeen

PlateSource.description: Where code read one of a truck's plates.
PlateSource.title: PlateSource

PolicyChange-Input.description:
A new version of the company's policy with only these fields changed from the one in force
when it is written: a screen that shows one setting never writes back another's stale value.
PolicyChange-Input.title: PolicyChange

PolicyChange-Output.description:
A new version of the company's policy with only these fields changed from the one in force
when it is written: a screen that shows one setting never writes back another's stale value.
PolicyChange-Output.title: PolicyChange

PolicyDraftOut.description: A change to the policy drafted in a chat, waiting for the owner or answered.
PolicyDraftOut.title: PolicyDraftOut

PolicyIn.description: A new version of the company's policy, replacing the one in force.
PolicyIn.title: PolicyIn

Preview.description: How the web app shows a file; a file with none is only downloaded.
Preview.title: Preview

ProjectJob.description:
The job as the project's conversations describe it together, worked out by code from what
a model read in each: for each field what most of them say, and each firm in one role only.
Firms go by their short names; the parties keep their full ones.
ProjectJob.title: ProjectJob

ProjectMerge.description: The owner saying this project and ``into`` are one job: ``into`` stays.
ProjectMerge.title: ProjectMerge

ProjectPartyAnswer.description: The owner's answer to a suggested firm.
ProjectPartyAnswer.title: ProjectPartyAnswer

ProjectPartyOut.description: A firm's role on a project: the owner's, or code's suggestion with what names it.
ProjectPartyOut.title: ProjectPartyOut

ProjectStage.description: Where the job stands, in order. Computed from its shipments and invoices, never typed.
ProjectStage.title: ProjectStage

ReadState.description:
Whether Tamga has read what a file says (ADR-0012). A document nobody asked to read (an
inline logo) has none.
ReadState.title: ReadState

Reason.description: Why a file could not be read, as the owner is told (ADR-0012).
Reason.title: Reason

RunApprove.description: The owner approves these bills of a run, each the evaluation it names, one at a time.
RunApprove.title: RunApprove

Said.description:
What the judge types as a persona: it arrives as that persona's message, through the
same intake as theirs.
Said.title: Said

ScenarioPolicy.description: How the scenario's company pays, as the judge may change it before it opens.
ScenarioPolicy.title: ScenarioPolicy

Settled.description: What is read of an invoice the books show open, beside its own figures.
Settled.title: Settled

ShipmentHitch.description:
The trailer a truck that has none takes: a plate as the board showed it, with the truck row
it stands on when it is another truck's lone plate (that row is then no truck of the job, and
one whose plate changed since is refused), or none for a plate seen on the job's papers or
mail.
ShipmentHitch.title: ShipmentHitch

ShipmentState.description:
Whether the truck is the owner's: one code proposed waits for a yes, and a rejected one
is kept so its plates are never proposed on that project again (ADR-0021).
ShipmentState.title: ShipmentState

Stance.description: How the controller leans when it weighs a bill the rules allow.
Stance.title: Stance

TaxIdEvidence.description: Where a tax number was seen in the company's own records.
TaxIdEvidence.title: TaxIdEvidence

TaxIdProposal.description:
A tax number the company's own sent mail gives, which no firm in its books has: Tamga's
guess at the company's own, for the owner to confirm.
TaxIdProposal.title: TaxIdProposal

ThreadSummary.description: A conversation: every mail sharing a thread key, a copy in another mailbox counted once.
ThreadSummary.title: ThreadSummary

TurnMessage.description:
Where Tamga began a turn on its own, carried as an activity message: why, in code's
words, and when, so the owner sees what started what follows.
TurnMessage.title: TurnMessage

TypeSource.description:
Who said what kind of file a document is: the owner's word stands, code and the model only
fill a type nobody gave.
TypeSource.title: TypeSource

WorldOut.description: A sandbox's world: its scenario, its clock, who plays in it, and what the script holds.
WorldOut.title: WorldOut

app__modules__linking__models__Outcome.description: What the linker made of a conversation (docs/architecture/09).
app__modules__linking__models__Outcome.title: Outcome

APIKeyCookie.description: Set by signing in, accepting an invite or opening a guest sandbox.
APIKeyCookie.name: tamga_session

get.description:
The model and reasoning effort a chat's answers are given, and the others a question
may be sent with: a run takes the choice in the protocol's `forwardedProps`, as
`{"model": …, "effort": …}`.
The company's chats: those this user has not read first, then the most recent.

post.description: Opens a chat. Sent again with the same id, it gives the chat that id already opened.

Writes the chat's earlier part into notes, which its runs are then sent in place of
those messages. It happens by itself before a run once the chat nears its window.

Answers the message the body carries, as a stream of the chat protocol's events (AG-UI).
The body is the protocol's run input; of its messages only the last, the new one, is read.

200.description: The run's AG-UI events, as they come

delete.description: Stops the answer being written in the chat, when one is.

get.description:
Whether the company's decision log still holds: each row's hash checked against what the
row says and the row before it.

The company's decision log, by its place in the chain, each row with its hash and the one
before it.

Decisions about the company's payables, by default the latest evaluated first; with
``id``, only those.

patch.description:
The owner's answer to the evaluation it names: 409 when it was evaluated again since, or
when a rule does not allow it.

get.description: Newest first, by when each file arrived or was last uploaded.

delete.description:
An uploaded file, with what was read from it. 409 when a mail brought it or a project holds
it as evidence (`held_by`).

patch.description:
Its type or the name Tamga shows it under; only the fields sent change. A new name keeps the
extension (400), and a file a mail or an archive brought keeps the name it came with (409,
`held_by`).

get.description: The file itself, for the web app to draw: inline only as a verified image or PDF.

A web page (`preview` html) made safe to show, as a mail's body is: for a frame that runs
no script and loads nothing from the web unless asked.

The files taken out of an archive or a winmail.dat, in their order there, each under the
name it had in it. Empty until the archive is read (`read_state`).
The PDF the converter made of a Word, RTF or OpenDocument file (`converted`).

A spreadsheet as Excel lays it out: each cell's value and number format, the styles, merged
cells, widths and heights. At most 20 sheets of a thousand rows and fifty columns.
An XML or text file (`preview` text) as text, up to a million characters.

What changes in the caller's company from now on: one note per kind and record, without
its content. The browser reads what changed through the resources it already uses.

What the invoices ``/invoices`` would list with the same filters add up to, per
currency.

parameters.description: True: not cancelled and something left to pay. False: cancelled, or nothing left. One the books give no amount left for is in neither.
parameters.name: outstanding

schema.description: True: not cancelled and something left to pay. False: cancelled, or nothing left. One the books give no amount left for is in neither.
schema.title: Outstanding

parameters.description: True: not cancelled and something left to pay. False: cancelled, or nothing left. One the books give no amount left for is in neither.
parameters.name: outstanding

schema.description: True: not cancelled and something left to pay. False: cancelled, or nothing left. One the books give no amount left for is in neither.
schema.title: Outstanding

get.description:
The company's memory: what its owner taught Tamga, and what a chat drafted for the owner
to confirm.

post.description: An entry the owner writes: it holds at once. The owner's only.

What was written, made into changes of the company's memory by a model that reads it
first (ADR-0030): entries added, changed or retired, and why. The owner's changes hold at
once; ops' only add, as drafts the owner confirms. With `entry_id`, an edit of that entry.
429 when the chat's requests for today are spent; 409 when nothing usable came back.

delete.description: The owner throws away a draft; 409 for an entry that held, which is retired instead.

patch.description: The owner corrects, confirms or retires an entry.

get.description: The mail as its server gave it (.eml), headers and every part, for a mail client.
The company's accounts: banks, cash boxes, the vault, and the books' estimate.

patch.description: An account the owner keeps; 409 for one a source reads.

get.description:
What the bank and cash accounts hold, and their total in ``currency`` at the reference
rate of the company's day, each rate with its day and source.

parameters.description: True: estimates from the books; false: none of them.
parameters.name: estimated

schema.description: True: estimates from the books; false: none of them.
schema.title: Estimated

post.description: A movement on an account the owner keeps; 409 for one a source reads.

parameters.description: Only parties whose balance in the books runs this way.
parameters.name: balance_side

schema.description: Only parties whose balance in the books runs this way.
schema.title: Balance Side

get.description:
The run for a day, by default the next pay day (today without one): what is due by the
next run, in the order it is weighed, and what the reserve leaves to pay it with.

The executor's releases from the company's vault, the latest first, each with its
transaction on the explorer once final.

The plates these projects' mail, papers and bills name, with where each was read and the
truck it is, if any.
What a judge can open a sandbox with; asked before anyone signs in.
The company's policy in force; version 0 is the defaults, while the owner has set none.

patch.description:
A new version of the policy with only the fields given changed from the one in force: the
owner's only.

put.description: A new version of the policy, in force from now: the owner's only.

get.description: A change to the policy drafted in a chat, and whether the owner answered it.

post.description: Puts the drafted change in force over the version in force now: the owner's only.
Drops the drafted change: the owner's only.

get.description: The reserve rules every company can pick, each one a start for a rule of the owner's own.

patch.description: The owner's yes or no to a firm code suggested; 409 when it is the owner's already.

get.description: The currencies the company's official reference rates convert, the base first.

post.description:
Makes another truck's lone plate, or a plate seen on the job, this truck's trailer; 409
when a truck or the plate changed since it was shown.
Makes the truck's trailer a truck of its own; returns the new truck.
Swaps the truck's plates as they stand; 409 when it has not both.

get.description: Conversations, the most recently active first; ``q`` matches any of their mails.

post.description: What Tamga wrote, in another language: read from what is kept, written once by a model.
